# Mamadou Diallo Ndoye

> Power Platform & data developer (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Data Factory). Also builds eTable, an Android app in Kotlin and Supabase. Handle: @mad0021. The site is bilingual (ES/EN) on one URL; add ?lang=en for English.

## What I do
- Apps: Power Apps (canvas and model-driven) on Dataverse, replacing shared spreadsheets.
- Flow: Power Automate cloud flows and approvals for repetitive work.
- Data: Data Factory pipelines and SQL that move data between systems.
- BI: Power BI dashboards with DAX and semantic models.

## Projects
- [eTable](https://github.com/mad0021/etable-supabase): restaurant floor management for Android tablets. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Supabase.

## Stack
Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Data Factory, Dataverse, SQL, Kotlin, TypeScript, React, Azure.

## Languages
Catalan and Spanish (native), English (C1).
